finding_1_batch_causal_binding.source_observation: Historical batch proposals/progress accept model-generated historical_chunk_id/source_event_id/extraction_pass without rebinding them to the canonical chunk/source/exact-next-pass tuple. _record_batch_progress uses max(current+1, claimed_pass), and saturation does not require an exhaustive envelope.
counterexample_classes: foreign source_event_id attached to an existing chunk
future or replayed extraction_pass advancing progress
oversized/truncated batch progressing as if exhaustive
required_regressions: foreign event cannot mutate chunk or ingest candidate
non-exhaustive zero-novel pass cannot claim saturation

finding_2_incremental_source_event_ident.source_observation: ingest_artifact_history persists byte_offset but resets local_line to zero on every incremental invocation. source_event_identity includes line_no, therefore one physical workers.jsonl row can receive a different source_event_id depending on max_new_lines/resume chunking.
finding_2_incremental_source_event_ident.counterexample: one-shot scan and three one-line resumed scans of the same file can assign different line_no/source_event_id pairs to physical rows after the first checkpoint
required_regressions: one-shot vs incremental resume yields identical absolute line/source_event_id identities
legacy offset-only checkpoint deterministically reconstructs completed absolute line count
inode/truncation reset offset and line checkpoint together
